applicant_profile: I am a data professional with a strong foundation in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience building scalable data pipelines, automating reporting workflows, and developing analytics solutions in the banking and risk domain. I previously worked as a Data Analyst at Wells Fargo, where I focused on designing efficient data processes, improving data quality, and delivering actionable insights through dashboards and automation. My core strengths lie in data engineering and analytics engineering. I have extensive experience working with Python for data processing and automation, and SQL for complex querying and data modeling. I am proficient in building end-to-end data workflows, including data ingestion, transformation, validation, and reporting. In my professional experience, I bring over seven years of hands-on experience working with Python and SQL. I have been responsible for developing end-to-end automated reporting pipelines that power dashboards across multiple risk domains, including risk management, controls, issue management, and remediation tracking. These workflows were typically orchestrated through scheduled jobs using tools such as cron. I also have experience applying natural language processing techniques, having developed a similarity detection system to identify related issues and controls across datasets. This involved leveraging cosine similarity alongside custom-trained word embeddings to surface meaningful relationships within large volumes of data. In addition, I have designed and implemented internal tools and reusable packages to standardize common workflows such as database access and query execution, ensuring consistency and reliability across the team’s outputs. For the majority of my career, I worked extensively with Microsoft SQL Server, and later expanded into modern data platforms including Snowflake and dbt. Over the past two years, I have focused on building modern ELT pipelines using dbt, structuring transformations across staging, intermediate, and mart layers while implementing robust data quality testing and source freshness checks. I have also gained exposure to tools such as BigQuery, Looker Studio, and GitHub Actions through personal projects, further strengthening my understanding of the modern data stack. I bring a strong problem-solving mindset, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. I am comfortable working cross-functionally, communicating complex data concepts clearly, and building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with business goals.
